item.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe is still missing 3 major Big Bang Theory cameos after 4 episodes — but creators claim that returning cast are simply 'who was available'
item.description: Should we be reading too deeply into who from The Big Bang Theory has returned to spinoff Stuart Fails to Save the Universe? Not according to its creators.

item.title: Trump declares 100 percent tariffs on many drones and all aircraft parts
item.description: The United States has already banned future foreign drones from entering the United States unless their companies kiss the ring - as well as routers, robots, and Roombas. Now, President Donald Trump is targeting existing drone imports and parts, too. He's going to try to make them cost a lot more. In a presidential action, […]
